## About
Abramson Automotive is a full service repair shop in Mesa, serving drivers from Tempe, Gilbert, Chandler and Scottsdale too. We are a licensed and certified shop, and we handle repairs along with your factory scheduled maintenance.
Jeff owns the shop and works as service writer, technician and fleet sales. Ed works alongside him as an automotive technician. It is a family operation: Jeff's daughter Kayla is our marketing manager, and his wife Karen Abramson is our marketing coordinator and event photographer.
Neighbors keep coming back because we tell it straight. If your car doesn't need a repair, we will say so. That's a big part of why we hold a 4.9 rating from 224 Google reviews.

## Services
- Brake repair: Brake inspections and repairs to keep you stopping safely.
- A/C repair and service: Getting your air conditioning working again for Mesa summers.
- Engine diagnostics: Finding out what is really going on when a warning light comes on.
- Lube, oil and filters: Routine oil changes and filter replacements.
- Factory scheduled maintenance: The maintenance your manufacturer recommends, handled here.
- Tire and wheel services: Tire and wheel work, including alignments.
- Clutch repairs and replacement: Clutch repair and full replacement when it is needed.
- Suspension repairs: Repairs to keep your ride steady and smooth.
- Intoxalock ignition interlock: We are an authorized installer for Intoxalock ignition interlock devices.
- Emergency tow: Emergency towing is available when your car can't make it here on its own.
- Fleet service: Repair and maintenance for business fleet accounts.

## FAQ
Q: What hours are you open?
A: We are open weekdays, Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We are in Mesa and serve drivers from all over the East Valley, including Tempe, Gilbert, Chandler and Scottsdale.

Q: Can I get a ride while my car is in the shop?
A: Yes. We offer a free shuttle within a certain local area. Give us a call to see if you are in range.

Q: How do I schedule an Intoxalock installation?
A: Call Intoxalock at (833) 918-1407 and tell them you would like to install with us. They will set up your account and book your appointment.
